http/internal/http2_fields#

Requests and responses as HTTP/2 field sections: pseudo-fields first, lowercase names, no connection-specific fields.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Requests and responses as HTTP/2 field sections: pseudo-fields first, lowercase names, no connection-specific fields.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.
